en: Color postcard showing a modernist two‑storey white post office with the PTTR (Poșta/Telecom) sign and the entrance marked POSTA. A small red CTS sign is on the wall. Trees line the street and three men stand talking on the sidewalk. The reverse has Romanian layout 'CARTE POSTALA', a Romanian 40 BANI stamp (Poșta Română) canceled 'CÂMPINA 13.11.72', price printed as Lei 1,90, and a caption indicating the subject is the PTTR office in Amara.
